text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win every race!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'll do things my way, and at my own
pace!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do my very best and cut no
corners
when it comes to taking care of
my body.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mumumumuuu!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crash!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Bwaaa! Th-the shrine bell fell down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have another bustling New Year's Day
with
Matikanetannhauser and her friends
this year.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff... Hm, I think I'm okay!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, that scared me. I wonder if my
prayer got
through?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: What did you pray for, Machitan?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, since we're starting our senior
year, I'm
thinking I might try and do
even bigger things this
year!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
There are a lot of amazing racers this
year. If I'm
not at the top of my game,
everyone's going to
leave me in the dust.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
McQueen is aiming for her third
consecutive spring Tenno Sho win and
Palmer has been
making a splash in the
G1 scene.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
There's a lot of attention on Flower as
well. Her
performance in the Sprint tour
has been
extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Everyone competing in the Classics this
year is
incredible too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Like Hayahide, Ticket, and Taishin. Oh,
I'm so
excited!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You find that exciting, huh? You sure
haven't
changed.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
By the by, Tannhauser. Do you have
some kind of
goal for the year?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Besides winning every race, I mean!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I do, but it's kinda embarrassing,
so it's a
secret.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later in the evening,
Matikanetannhauser stops
me as we're
about to part ways.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um, there's something I want to say
that's for
your ears only.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's about my goal. This year,
I... I
want to
find myself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I've been thinking about what the
director
said at summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get what she meant when
she said I
inspire people because I'm me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm me... Like, what? It makes
me all
fidgety just thinking about it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I think that's because I don't really
understand
myself very well to begin
with.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If I want to live up to the director's
expectations,
then I need to understand
myself first!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I'm gonna use this year to
find
myself!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So let's work really hard! How should we
kick
things off?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The perfect training for today is...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! But it's the very first day!
choice_data_list: Since it's a special occasion, the...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That means we'll go all out starting
tomorrow,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it! I'm already plenty
motivated! In that
case, I'll take your
advice and save my energy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right! Time to sleep!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we start this year's training
rather
peacefully.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A full regimen! You mean going back
and forth
between the track, gym, and
pool?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Sounds fun! Where should I start? Oh,
it's so hard
to decide!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I know! I'll make my own decision
spinner! My first
test of luck for the year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we start this year's training
rather
peacefully.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! I love a good stealth mission!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And I've got the perfect plan—I'll
disguise myself
as a bush and head to
the track!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, but while I'm at it, what if I
dressed up as a
ninja bush?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we start this year's training
rather
peacefully.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Many tough opponents await us in our
senior
year. I want us to do everything
we can to beat all
of them!
